payload.reason: The evidence provides information about the annotation methods and performance metrics related to grammatical errors, which can be considered as baseline models for evaluating tagging and parsing accuracy.

claims.text: The baseline models involve dual annotation of sentences in original and error-corrected forms to assess the impact of grammatical errors on tagging and parsing.
Performance metrics indicate that grammatical errors lead to significant degradation in POS tagging and parsing accuracy, establishing a baseline for comparison.
The ESL conventions and guidelines used for annotation serve as a baseline model for addressing grammatical errors in the treebank.
